title: Processing and characterization of W23Mo23V17Cr8Ta7Fe22 and WMoVCrTa refractory high entropy alloys
process_description: prepared by mechanical alloying using hardened steel vials and milling balls with 10:1 ball-to-powder ratio at 250 RPM for 48 hours, followed by cold isostatic pressing at 276 MPa and four re-melts in vacuum arc furnace under argon atmosphere

title: Processing and characterization of W23Mo23V17Cr8Ta7Fe22 and WMoVCrTa refractory high entropy alloys
process_description: prepared by mechanical alloying using ceramic vial and ceramic milling balls followed by vacuum arc melting with four re-melts under argon atmosphere
